summary: Localize comfort, remote and grouping controls in English and Swedish and match their surfaces to each card's theme.
scope: Q01 controls labels, unknown-state text, native select options and per-card contrast

verification.typecheck: Passed after widget and dictionary changes.
verification.browser: All three locale/theme cases passed across focused Chromium runs, plus four media-group regression cases. The corrected actual per-card light/dark fixtures verify enabled button/select contrast >= 4.5 against the dialog surfaces, legible native option colors and Swedish preview guards with zero service calls.
verification.visual: Inspected regenerated 390px dark/light grouping screenshots and Swedish remote/grouping plus comfort/remote theme screenshots. Grouping actions are legible in both card themes; the root media-dialog token fix resolves the light-theme failure.

limits: Reported integration option names remain unchanged; service values are never translated.
The localization slice covers comfort, remote and grouping widgets, not every editor or earlier advanced control.
Browser viewport checks do not establish physical-device or companion-app acceptance.
